title: Implement --temp-dir CLI argument and tmpfs detection logic
description:
Add a new --temp-dir <path> flag to main.py cmd_optimize(). Follow the Strangler Fig pattern: grow new detection code alongside existing /tmp default, do NOT remove it. Implementation:

1. Add get_best_temp_location(repo_path, debug) helper that checks /dev/shm availability and space via du -sb, falling back to tempfile.gettempdir() (preserving old behavior).
2. In the per-job loop where tempfile.mkdtemp() is called (~main.py L254), use the new function to choose location instead of mkdtemp. User-specified --temp-dir overrides auto-detect.
3. Add argparse flag --temp-dir with no default (None triggers auto-detect).

All three code paths must coexist: explicit path, tmpfs detection, and old /tmp fallback.
close_reason: Implemented: get_repo_disk_usage(), get_best_temp_location() helpers, CLI arg wiring in cmd_optimize()

title: Add tmpfs temp directory support for faster optimization
description: When running the optimizer with multiple parallel jobs, each job creates a temporary copy of the repository in /tmp. On Linux, using /dev/shm (tmpfs) instead of disk-based /tmp can provide 10-50x speedup for file I/O operations during repo copying and cleanup. This feature adds an optional --temp-dir argument with automatic detection of tmpfs filesystems when available.
close_reason: Superseded by cfa-xok
